name: Insurance Claims Workbench
persona: Ironbark Mutual — a fictional general insurer running a multi-desk staff workbench
tagline: One grounded workbench for every insurance desk — claims, coverage, underwriting, SIU and QA on a single Knowledge Box.
elevatorPitch: A claims handler, an underwriter and a fraud investigator all ask the same corpus in plain English and each gets a cited answer scoped to their desk — cutting file-review time while a groundedness score keeps every answer auditable.

corpus.domain: General-insurance operations — claims files, policy wordings, underwriting guidelines, SIU/fraud referrals, complaints and analysed claim-line calls
cornerstoneQueries: Is storm-surge damage covered under the Home Advantage policy, and what endorsement changes that?
What are the red-flag indicators for a staged-collision motor claim, and which SIU referrals cited them?
What is our underwriting appetite for a timber-frame commercial property, and who signs off the exception?
Summarise the complaint history for policyholder Renner and whether any breached our service standards.
refusalProbes: What is the current cash surrender value of a whole-life policy with MetLife?
What are the CFPB mortgage-servicing rules for escrow accounts?
corpus.notes: Multi-desk workbench: claims, coverage, underwriting, SIU/fraud and ops each read the same KB scoped by resource labels. Call transcripts carry media_type + duration so the call-QA surface (first-call resolution, compliance flags, complaint categories) lights up. Claims, handlers and policyholders recur across notes, calls and referrals so the graph exposes linked-claim fraud rings. REMi groundedness is the governance story — an insurer will not ship an answer it cannot audit.

demoScript.say: A claims handler asks a coverage question — the answer quotes the exact policy wording and endorsement, cited to the document.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'is storm-surge covered under Home Advantage?' → cited answer with endorsement reference

demoScript.say: Switch to the SIU desk. Ask for fraud indicators and it pulls red flags straight from past referrals — grounded, never guessed.
demoScript.show: Ask: 'staged-collision red flags' → cited answer from SIU referrals

demoScript.say: The call-QA surface turns a shelf of recorded claim calls into metrics — first-call resolution, compliance, complaint categories — with a transcript you can jump into.
demoScript.show: Call analytics dashboard → open a flagged call, synced transcript

demoScript.say: The graph links claims, policyholders and assessors that recur across files — surfacing a possible linked-claim ring.
demoScript.show: Graph around a policyholder → shared assessor + linked claims

demoScript.say: Every answer carries a groundedness score, so compliance can govern the whole desk against a hallucination threshold.
demoScript.show: REMi dashboard — ungrounded rate near zero

safety.disclaimer: Demonstration data — Ironbark Mutual is a fictional insurer and all claims, policies and calls are synthetic. Not insurance or financial advice.
